name: 東望洋跑道

origin.note: the apex of the bend where the circuit leaves Avenida da Amizade for Avenida de Lopo Sarmento de Carvalho (OSM relation 8877949, ways 753546939 and 1231146594)

rotNote: Avenida da Amizade comes in at a bearing of about 248° (towards the bend): turned 22° clockwise it runs along the game's x axis, the cars coming in from the right, the exit up the screen

plan.note: the bend, the straight into it, the climb out of it as far as Estrada de São Francisco, the grandstand's park
